answer: A hostile operator running 126 aliases therefore needs 30 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in plume, expire in tide, and jade lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1261 identities would post 2335 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
